assumptions: Nominal 17 ft fully extended arms; video exact extension, taper, included angle and metal grade not measured.
30 degrees above horizontal (120 degree included upward V) is a study choice, not a transcript measurement.
Uniform effective radius and stainless conductivity, with no joint contact resistance or whip bending.
Homebrew scenarios reuse our 58 ft doublet line uncertainty, not measurements of the video 18 AWG line.
Wet stress is a deliberately adverse hypothetical case, not measured wet/icy line behavior.
10 meters is the video line length at 12:36; 20 meters is retained only as a comparison.
Mast is a floating uniform lossy wire proxy. Balanced line and truck are absent from NEC; line-mast common-mode coupling is not modeled.
A 6 cm excitation bridge split into three collinear segments isolates the source from arm bends; numerical validation tests the reference geometry in lossless free space.
